:::{#def-classification}
#### Classification

A **classification problem** is a statistical problem in which
we seek to assign each observation to one of two or more discrete categories (**classes**)
based on its observed features or predictors $x$,
using a **classification rule** $c$ that maps features to classes:

$$c: x \mapsto c(x) \in \mathcal{C}$$ {#eq-classification}

where $\mathcal{C}$ is a set of $K$ classes
(for example, $\mathcal{C} = \set{1, \dots, K}$,
or a set of text labels).

In the binary case ($K = 2$),
the two classes are often labeled "positive" and "negative",
or "diseased" and "healthy".

:::
